item.title: Glenbrook athlete earns milestone through grit, determination
item.description: By Paige Gurgainers For most high school basketball athletes, the 1,000-point milestone is a career-defining moment. For Carson Powell, a sophomore at Glenbrook School, it was a moment earned through grit, discipline and years of quiet work long before the spotlight ever found him.
